The villains of the Elvenbane fortress, west of Ab'Dendriel, have a crystal ball they use to spy on the elves' war talks. {npc:Eroth} gives you a {item:Mirror} to reflect the ball's power and destroy it. You climb to the top of the central Elvenbane tower, use the mirror on the {item:Scrying Ball} and receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and an {item:Elven Amulet}.
